<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn/contract">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShopQuery" name="Shop query"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShopOffers" name="Shop offers"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Parts order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Reorder" name="Parts reorder"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Complaint" name="Complaint email"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Contract">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Contract" name="Contract project" processRef="Process_Contract"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_WebShops" name="Web shops"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Query" name="Query all web shops" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_ShopQuery"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offers" name="Shop offers" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" messageRef="Message_ShopOffers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Parts orders" sourceRef="Task_SendOrders" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReorderCheapest" name="Cheapest reorder" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_Reorder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReorderFastest" name="Fastest reorder" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_Reorder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Complaint" name="Complaint email" sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Contract" name="Contract" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Contract" name="Contract project starts">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Query</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_QueryShops" name="Query all web shops">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Query</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Query_Receive</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageRef>Message_ShopQuery</bpmn:messageRef>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffers" name="Receive shop offers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Query_Receive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Receive_Assess</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageRef>Message_ShopOffers</bpmn:messageRef>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssessOffers" name="Find available quantities, prices, and delivery times">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Receive_Assess</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Assess_Allocate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AllocateParts" name="Allocate parts to the cheapest offers, splitting across shops if needed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Assess_Allocate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Allocate_List</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateList" name="Create a list of parts to order from each shop">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Allocate_List</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_List_Order</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendOrders" name="Order parts from each shop">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_List_Order</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Order_FirstBatch</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageRef>Message_Order</bpmn:messageRef>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FirstBatch" name="First parts batch arrives">
      <bpmn:documentation>Parts arrive in batches in a random order, typically about two days earlier or later.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Order_FirstBatch</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FirstBatch_Build</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Build" name="Build contract">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FirstBatch_Build</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Build_CheckStock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckStock" name="Check stock for each part">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Build_CheckStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Check_Below5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Below5" name="Is stock below 5?" default="Flow_Below5_No">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Check_Below5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Below5_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Below5_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder from the cheapest shop">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Below5_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Cheapest_Below3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageRef>Message_Reorder</bpmn:messageRef>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Below3" name="Is stock below 3?" default="Flow_Below3_No">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Cheapest_Below3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Below3_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Below3_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder again from the fastest shop">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Below3_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Fastest_Zero</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageRef>Message_Reorder</bpmn:messageRef>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockZero" name="Is stock zero?" default="Flow_Zero_No">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Below5_No</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Below3_No</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Fastest_Zero</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Zero_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Zero_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EmailFriends" name="Email friends to complain about the web shops">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Zero_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Email_End</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageRef>Message_Complaint</bpmn:messageRef>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_StockChecked">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Zero_No</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Below5_No</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ComplaintSent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Email_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Query" sourceRef="StartEvent_Contract" targetRef="Task_QueryShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Query_Receive" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Assess" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Task_AssessOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assess_Allocate" sourceRef="Task_AssessOffers" targetRef="Task_AllocateParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Allocate_List" sourceRef="Task_AllocateParts" targetRef="Task_CreateList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_List_Order" sourceRef="Task_CreateList" targetRef="Task_SendOrders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_FirstBatch" sourceRef="Task_SendOrders" targetRef="Event_FirstBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FirstBatch_Build" sourceRef="Event_FirstBatch" targetRef="Task_Build"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_CheckStock" sourceRef="Task_Build" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_Below5" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_Below5"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Below5_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Below5" targetRef="Task_ReorderCheapest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock < 5</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Below5_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Below5" targetRef="Gateway_StockZero"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cheapest_Below3" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_Below3"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Below3_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Below3" targetRef="Task_ReorderFastest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock < 3</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Below3_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Below3" targetRef="Gateway_StockZero"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fastest_Zero" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Gateway_StockZero"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Zero_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_StockZero" targetRef="Task_EmailFriends">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock = 0</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Zero_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_StockZero" targetRef="EndEvent_StockChecked"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Email_End" sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="EndEvent_ComplaintSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
